facts.fact: Devan asks Rema to enter his binding to Neela, odiyan, on the high court's roll, a crown record naming him as harbouring an odiyan in his own voice; Rema warns it goes to Kodiyur and Neela confirms it in public.

Usha takes a second wound-share with Lata, so she now bleeds for both Lata and the queen; Lata can be caged only with Usha's voice joined to her own, and the queen's old witness claim on Lata is voided.
